Question 11
?

Solve the initial value problem x′(t)=[−21−1−4]x(t),x(0)=[01]. Hint: The only eigenvalue of the system's matrix is λ=−3.

a
 [te−3t(1−t)e−3t]
b
 [4te−3t(1+t)e−3t]
c
 [te−3t(1−2t)e−3t]
d
 [4te−3t(1−2t)e−3t]
e
 [te−3te−3t]
